title: ledger_fold_write_failed event payload v0.2 (FUS-LEDGER-FOLD-STATE)
description: ADR-0010 §14.28 审查修复 (FUS-LEDGER-FOLD-STATE external-file design): an external-ledger append failure at a fold advance — the fold state is rolled back (the rows stay in the view, never lost), the failure is counted (attempt = 1-based consecutive failure count since the last successful append), and after the failure budget (FOLD_WRITE_FAILURE_LIMIT = 3; disabled=true) folding is disabled for the rest of the loop (the view falls back to the full original messages and compaction remains the backstop). rows = the number of rows the failed append carried; view_estimate_tokens = the chars/2 estimate that triggered the advance; agent_role is the lane — folding is main-lane only, so the producer always writes "main" (the enum mirrors request_header_change for shape uniformity).

ledger_path.description: Path of the external ledger file the append failed for ({session_cwd}/.gsa/ledger/current.md).

attempt.description: 1-based consecutive failure count since the last successful append — strictly increasing by 1 across consecutive failures of the same run; the budget is exhausted at FOLD_WRITE_FAILURE_LIMIT = 3.

disabled.description: True when the failure budget is exhausted — folding is disabled for the rest of the loop (attempt >= FOLD_WRITE_FAILURE_LIMIT).

rows.description: Number of ledger rows the failed append carried.

view_estimate_tokens.description: The chars/2 estimate of the request view that triggered the fold advance.

agent_role.description: The agent lane — folding is main-lane only, so the producer always writes "main".
